decision: The best descriptive structured 4k group is `bit_reversed_blocks` group 3 with MSE 5.4744e-06, -1.93% versus direct 4096 RQMC. Its paired win fraction is 0.467, and its paired MSE difference is -1.07962e-07 with standard error 8.82662e-07. The true-coset average has effective error correlation -0.03512; its largest leave-one-out penalty is 3.57613e-07 (5.4% of the reduction from the average individual coset to the six-way mean). The small descriptive improvement is not paired-consistent and was found on this same development data. No individual group or coset is responsible for most of the 24k gain.
